text: Vespa handled the personalized news feed at scale; tensor expressions in the ranking phase kept feature blending inside the engine, not in a sidecar service.
2FA shipped as TOTP plus ten single-use recovery codes downloaded once at enrolment; the recovery list is Argon2-hashed server side and never stored in plaintext.
Wrote an R Markdown pipeline that turns the Polar heart rate export into a PDF exercise physiology journal mailed to my coach Saturday mornings.
dbt Core models compile into the warehouse-native SQL dialect; state-based selection lets CI only rebuild what changed downstream.
CAA records were pinned to Let's Encrypt and BuyPass on the apex; third-party CAs were blocked from issuing even on social-engineered domain control checks.
Style Dictionary builds the token pipeline; JSON source files under tokens/ transform into CSS custom properties, Swift enums, and Android XML in one pnpm run.
direnv with per-repo .envrc kept secrets out of shell rc files; the use_flake helper wires Nix dev shells in cleanly without manual sourcing.
tsan and ubsan opt-in builds now run nightly on a dedicated Bazel config; the release pipeline stays asan-free because of the 2x runtime cost.
Pa11y CI runs against the staging URL on every deploy and uploads the HTML report as an artefact; the threshold is set at zero errors and ten warnings, tightening each sprint.
Coffee rule while travelling: no espresso after 14:00 local; learned the hard way after a white night in Rome.
The scientific method cycles through observation, hypothesis, experiment, analysis, and revision.
Great Expectations guarded the landing-zone data contracts; expectations in YAML plus Airflow gated loads into the warehouse raw schema.
User namespace remapping on Docker daemon was enabled for the shared CI hosts; container root mapped to host UID 100000 so any escape landed on an unprivileged user.
The Sunday self-care block is 16:00 to 19:00, no calendar invites allowed; bath, journal, slow tea, no screens until the lights go down.
Right-to-left reviews land through a Playwright matrix that runs every route under `ar` and `he` locales; the screenshot diff gates PRs so layout regressions are caught before translators see them.
Exemplars wire Prometheus histograms to Tempo trace IDs; one click on a slow-latency bucket jumps straight to a matching span.
Donald Rubin's potential outcomes framework, developed across the 1970s, recast causal inference around counterfactual comparisons rather than structural equations.
User namespaces mapped the rootless container UID 0 to an unprivileged host UID; the /etc/subuid range of 65536 covered the common image needs.
RTL support ships via the dir attribute on html and logical CSS properties like padding-inline-start; hard-coded left and right values in the design tokens were all replaced.
Glimcher's neuroeconomics builds on temporal-difference dopamine accounts by treating basal-ganglia prediction error as the substrate of value learning.
Apache Hudi's merge-on-read table kept a row-oriented Avro delta log next to Parquet base files; near-real-time ingestion avoided full Parquet rewrites.
Watching Andrej Karpathy's neural network lectures on YouTube before bed most weekends.
The 2026-04-19 road-trip prep for Cornwall included a full Outback service on 2026-04-15, a new set of Bridgestone Weather Control tyres, and a roof-box leak test with the hose.
Descheduler evicts pods that violate topology spread long after scheduling; pairs with Karpenter for fleet hygiene.
Red Hat Satellite provisioned the RHEL patch baseline; the content views pinned errata so the monthly CVE batch landed identically on 300 hosts.
Repo-local pre-commit hooks live in .pre-commit-config.yaml and run the same ruff and mypy passes as CI; dev-laptop fails now match CI fails.
Carved the billing surface out of the monolith behind a strangler-fig proxy in Kong; traffic shifted 10% per week with a kill switch on the header.
Swapped a raw loader for an explicit allowlisted deserialiser using dill's dispatch table; the ingestion worker no longer accepts arbitrary class instances from disk.
The USGS National Earthquake Information Center in Golden, Colorado operates the Advanced National Seismic System catalogue that underpins modern hazard maps.

HomeAssistant's tesla_custom integration pulling through the fleet telemetry endpoint replaced the polling teslamate_mqtt topic on 2026-04-24 once the 5-minute rate limit on the old TeslaMate API killed the live dashboard.
Watchdog timers wrap every long-running goroutine in the streaming ingestor; a stuck stage gets cancelled at the 90-second mark and the supervisor restarts only that stage.
The TrolMaster Hydro-X handles the flower-tent CO2 PPFD ramp because the Climate module integrates directly with the Titan Controls CO2 generator on the 2026-01-15 build.
The Plum Wine Preserver kept the Coravin off the counter for nightly tastings because Plum's RFID bottle recognition logged the Burgundy pours into Vivino without any phone scan.

Core Data migrations run as lightweight unless the mapping model exists; the app pre-creates NSPersistentStoreDescription with shouldInferMappingModelAutomatically off for the v4-to-v5 custom migration.
Marvin handles the ad-hoc classification prompts in the triage worker; cast_to a Literal type returns an enum-like value directly and saves us the switch statement in app code.
SNS fan-out into multiple SQS subscribers lets the billing pipeline branch into retry, archive, and analytics without coupling.
Started the retirement glidepath spreadsheet in 2025 with a target of fully out by 58; the 529 plans for both kids are on a parallel track.
Preview environments wire a per-PR flag prefix so a branch under review can flip flags without leaking into staging; the CI step patches evaluationContext.environment to pr-<num>.
Shared the stormwater GIS layers on QGIS Cloud so the neighbourhood association meeting could project them without anyone installing the desktop client.
The Nvidia Shield TV Pro still wins for Kodi because the Tegra's HD audio bitstreaming keeps DTS-HD MA tracks intact and the Jellyfin for Kodi add-on treats it like a thin client.
Traefik handled the ACME DNS-01 challenge against Route53; wildcard certs covered the customer-tenant subdomains without pinning a cert per tenant.
The book club at Harbourside Library meets the last Thursday of each month at 19:30; we alternate fiction and non-fiction, and Priya picks the March slot.
The self-study plan board on the fridge lists three active tracks for 2026 Q2: Spanish to B1, Roman history to 180 AD, piano to RCM grade 3 equivalent.
Running Ollama on the Mac Studio for local summarisation of personal journals every Sunday.
Each ADR carries a confidence tag of low, medium or high; a low tag commits us to a revisit date and a small experiment ticket before the next quarter closes.
The menu-planning workflow for dinners lands on Wednesdays for a Saturday party: one make-ahead main, one room-temperature side, one dessert that sits happily.
Google Calendar now shares a custom feed with Outlook at the office so Priya's daycare pickups show up in my work view.
The board-game night at the flat tops out at six players because the dining table seats six and the kitchen island fits two more for the snack queue.
The Sonos Era 300 in the kitchen now plays Dolby Atmos Music from Amazon Music while the older Play:1 in the hallway handles announcements from Home Assistant.
A Better Routeplanner on the phone planned the 2026-05-24 Denver-to-Moab run with two CCS stops while the in-car Tesla planner wanted three because ABRP accepted the manual 65 mph cap.
Scrivener holds the novel draft outline while iA Writer handles the daily morning pages because iA's grayscale focus mode keeps me from fiddling with chapter structure at 6am.
Capability discovery goes through a GET /.well-known/api-capabilities resource that enumerates enabled features; the SDK caches it per base URL for the process lifetime.
Azure Key Vault stored the signing certificate for the payment webhook; the HSM-backed premium tier stopped the private key from ever leaving FIPS 140-2 Level 2 boundary.
Domain services hold logic that doesn't fit a single aggregate; pricing calculation takes an Order, a PricingPolicy, and a TaxTable and returns a PriceBreakdown without owning state.
PackPoint generated the base checklist for the Patagonia trek but the custom gear list moved into a Google Keep note because PackPoint couldn't track loaned crampons.
Obsidian's Readwise Official plugin pulls every new highlight into a per-book note at 6am, and the Dataview query rolls the month's new quotes into the daily journal without any copy-paste.
Debezium streams Postgres CDC events into Kafka so downstream services stay consistent without polling.
Wrote an AGENTS.md alongside CLAUDE.md so both Codex and Claude Code pick up the same canonical instructions; duplication beats divergence when two agents share the repo.
Maven's enforcer plugin bans duplicate classes and snapshot dependencies on release builds; a maven-enforcer-plugin rule called requireReleaseDeps runs in the release profile.
Public enums are open sets in the SDKs: unknown variants deserialise into a typed Unknown(str) wrapper instead of crashing old clients.
Doppler ran the secrets injection for the Vercel monorepo; the CLI's scoped tokens beat the old Heroku-style config vars per app.
The ingestion pipeline writes to Kafka, and a Flink job fans out events to Elasticsearch and S3.
CSP headers enforce strict-dynamic plus SRI hashes on every bundle; one inline script removal took a week but bounced an XSS class.
NIH grant reviews run through study sections; primary reviewers score and lead discussion during panel.
Fulcio issued the short-lived signing certificates tied to GitHub OIDC; release provenance pointed back to the exact workflow run via the certificate subject.
Multi-variate flag 'cart-layout' serves four string variants weighted 40/30/20/10; the default is pinned in code so a provider outage serves 'classic' instead of throwing.
The newborn sleep routine locks a 7pm bath, feed, swaddle, then dark room by 7:30pm; naps at 9, 12, 3 during the day.
Gender-aware strings use ICU `select`; the profile page picks `{gender, select, female {...} male {...} other {...}}` rather than stitching phrases so translators preserve agreement.
NVIDIA Ada Lovelace cards ran the DLSS 3.5 Ray Reconstruction path; the OFA motion vectors fed Frame Generation inside a single GPU frame.
GOAP is layered on top of the behaviour-tree fallback in the stealth game; planner computes a sequence of actions and the BT executes them, so ad-hoc subgoals stop hard-coding paths.
Python's contextvars carry the current span across asyncio tasks; the OpenTelemetry SDK's context.attach is wrapped in a helper that pairs detach in a finally block.
Design doc graveyard keeps retired proposals under /docs/retired with a redirect stub; search results still find them but with a prominent do-not-use banner.
The overnight-guest kit for the spare room at 14 Pennant Mews: fresh towels, USB-C charger, two pillows firm and soft, a carafe on the bedside.
The Voicemeeter Banana virtual mixer on the streaming PC routes the Reaper monitor mix into OBS Studio without doubling the latency that a single ASIO driver would cause on the X32 interface.
Focus traps on every modal are implemented with focus-trap-react; the trap records the opener, moves focus to the first tabbable on open, and restores on close.
A self-hosted Pi-hole on the Raspberry Pi 4 in the basement blocks the ad domains that kept slipping past YouTube Kids on the living-room Apple TV.
Introduced tech-radar entries tied to ADRs: moving a technology from assess to adopt always has an ADR id on the radar card, never a free-form note.
Long-codebase context for the 1.2M-LOC Python service uses semantic chunking plus a BM25 first stage; pure embeddings missed the right module on cross-cutting changes.
GraphQL reference uses the Docusaurus GraphQL plugin; introspection runs at build time so schema drift surfaces as a red CI instead of a stale page.
All services emit structured JSON via structlog; the gateway injects a correlation_id header for tracing.
Twitch chat moderation runs through Sery_Bot with a custom Python handler for the Friday Celeste streams plus a Discord webhook for VOD clips.
Swimming 2 km at London Fields Lido on Sunday mornings; the outdoor water wakes me up faster than espresso.
Scala's cats library implements recursion schemes over pattern-matching on algebraic data types for typed functional programming.
The International Ocean Discovery Program, launched in 2013, now coordinates the JOIDES Resolution, Chikyu, and mission-specific platforms for scientific ocean drilling.
The Bristol-to-Lisbon international move used a 20-foot shipping container through Allied Van Lines; quoted £4,800, three-week transit, end-of-May door-to-door.
AWS SQS standard queues backed the email send fan-out; at-least-once with idempotent handlers was cheaper than chasing exactly-once across services.
KMS envelope encryption wrapped per-tenant DEKs for the multi-tenant SaaS; the KEK in KMS rotated yearly, while DEKs rotated on tenant key-event.
Built a Discord bot in Go that rotates the arXiv machine learning digest into the paper-reading channel every morning at 8 AM sharp.

Invariants that span aggregates go through a saga with eventual consistency, not a distributed transaction; the book line from Vernon 'do not cross aggregate boundaries in one tx' is pinned in the module doc.
Piped my Readwise highlights into Zotero every Sunday evening so the PDF annotations sit next to the ebook quotes for thesis prep.
Sentry SDK init runs once in main with traces_sample_rate pulled from env; the before_send hook scrubs PII fields and drops handled-domain errors so noise stays tractable.
The neighbour at flat 4B, Iris, shares the parcel-collection arrangement; she takes mine on Tuesdays and Thursdays and I take hers on weekends.
Hauled a Neumann KM184 pair plus a Zoom F3 recorder to the cabin so Ana could capture the creek for the ambient EP she owes her label.
The Kardia 6L ECG feeds directly into the MyChart portal for dad's cardiologist at Mayo because the atrial-fibrillation strips catch episodes that the Apple Watch ECG misses between readings.
OctoPrint on the Raspberry Pi 4 lets the Bambu X1C and the Voron 2.4 share a single web UI on the workshop tablet even though the upstream Bambu firmware fights the API connection.
Trace IDs land in every log line via an slog handler that pulls trace.SpanContextFromContext at write time; Loki queries can pivot from a log to its trace by id without a join.
The social-media fast on 2026-03-15 through 2026-03-21 covered Reddit, Instagram, HackerNews and the Mastodon client Ivory; kept Signal open for family.
The dinner-party rota among the four households resets each January; we host February and June, the Bhattacharyas host April and October, and so on.
Tenant budget overruns emit a structured BudgetExceeded event; the SDK wrapper converts it to a 429-shaped response so upstream callers reuse their existing backoff code.
Embrace sits alongside Sentry for session timelines; Sentry handles the crash signal while Embrace's network and user-flow breadcrumbs drive the release health dashboard.
